items.label: 【Easy to Fly
items.value: Master the Sky Instantly】 No experience? No problem! Equipped with One-Key Takeoff/Landing and Altitude Hold, this beginner friendly drone stays rock-solid in the air. It’s so easy to fly that even kids 8-12 and adults who have never flown can master the controls in seconds. Perfect for stable indoor outdoor play, ensuring a stress-free start for every new pilot.

items: 【1080P HD Camera & Real-Time FPV View】 Capture your world from a brand-new perspective! The integrated 1080P HD camera delivers crystal-clear aerial snapshots and smooth FPV live video directly to your phone. Use Gesture Selfie to snap photos with a simple hand movement—making it the ultimate smart gadget for creative family fun, backyard adventures, or park exploration.

【Double the Flight for Non-Stop Entertainment】 Enjoy twice the joy with 2 modular batteries, providing up to 24 minutes of total flight time. This foldable mini drone is compact and comes with a premium carrying case, making it a portable lightweight companion. Whether it's a camping trip, a beach day, or a weekend family garden play, your aerial entertainment never has to stop.

【Thrilling Smart Features for Exciting Play】 Take your recreational flight to the next level! Master breathtaking 360° 3D Flips, steer by tilting your phone with Gravity Control, or design custom paths with Trajectory Flight via the Smart App. With 3-speed adjustments, this RC quadcopter offers a versatile and exciting pastime that grows with your skills, from casual drifting to high-speed stunts.

【Safe, Durable & Worry-Free House Fun】 Safety is our priority for every hobbyist. Featuring Headless Mode for easy orientation and 4 protective propeller guards to withstand accidental bumps. Built with high-toughness materials, this small drone is safe for indoor play and sturdy enough for outdoor exploration. It’s the go-to flying toy for boys and girls seeking a reliable and fun-filled adventure.
